sentences.text: Today, petitioner's counsel submits that they have voluntarily complied with the previous orders and handed over the affidavit to the investigator, regarding declaration of assets.
He further submits that main accused has already been granted benefit of anticipatory bail and the said order is not assailed by the State so far.

4. Considering the fact that petitioner was beneficiary and allegations relating to excess payment of Rs.11,23,000/- which the petitioner disputes and the fact that initially the State had filed cancellation report and after that at the instance of Court, further investigation had initiated and the amount involved coupled with the fact that petitioner had declared assets, his case is different from other accused and he is on better footings, as such he makes out a case for bail.
5. Consequently, petition is allowed and interim order dated 15.12.2023 is made absolute.
It is clarified that since the case of the petitioner is on different footings, other accused shall not be entitled to claim parity with the present petitioner for the reasons mentioned above.
Pending applications, if any, stand disposed of.
